description:
User explicitly approved RAM-only Mnesia on 2026-10-13 after discussion of restart message-decryption risk. No disk state, checkpoints or replication. Preserve existing unrelated BO worktree edits. No Git mutations authorized.
Policies: docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/system-config.md, docs/services/engine.md; docs/documentation.md before docs edits.
Architecture: Channels owns profile-scoped Mnesia ram_copies table; only session and sender_key namespaces are volatile. Pairing creds and other protocol records remain encrypted through Engine. Keep per-call confidential Engine binding validation for RAM access. User approves loss on node/Mnesia restart; listener restart retains RAM state. No new UI; no new E2E required.
Update owner docs/services/channels.md and system-config.md, engine.md new document operation, architecture.md RAM lifecycle; no policy duplication. Run mix q and focused integration suites per implementation issue, review final diff and mix precommit with 900000ms timeout. Record validation failures accurately. Test actual restart loss in isolated BEAM and preserve credentials in PostgreSQL. Action reuse not applicable to docs; review implementation assessments. Coverage phase follows PR-review approval and is not prematurely invoked. No commits/pushes.
